levels.description: Gains 1 SP every 5s for every [Advance Detector] or other [Sensor Hub] on the map; when skill is activated, generates a <@ba.enemy>Blocker</> (grants <@ba.drop>Sniper Advancement Tokens</> and <@ba.drop>Specialist Advancement Tokens</> once defeated) or a <@ba.enemy>Sponsor Drone</> (grants <@ba.drop>Sniper Advancement Tokens</>, <@ba.drop>Specialist Advancement Tokens</> and a <@ba.drop>Plug-in Supply Depot</> once defeated)
